Passage:
Camping in the Mountains (by Sarah, age 14)

Last month, my family and I went camping in the mountains. It was my first time sleeping in a tent, so I was very excited but also a little bit worried. We drove for four hours to reach the campsite. When we arrived, the weather was beautiful and sunny.

My dad and brother tried to put the tent up, but it was quite difficult. Finally, after an hour, it was ready. We put our sleeping bags inside and went for a walk. We saw some amazing birds and a small river. I wanted to swim, but the water was too cold!

In the evening, my mom cooked dinner on a small fire. We had sausages and beans. It tasted delicious because we were so hungry. After dinner, we sat around the fire and my dad told us some funny stories. It was very dark, and I could see thousands of stars in the sky. I don't usually see so many stars in the city.

Sleeping in the tent was strange at first because the ground was quite hard. However, I was very tired, so I fell asleep quickly. I woke up early the next morning to the sound of birds. It was a fantastic trip, and I can't wait to go camping again next year!
Evidence: I was very excited but also a little bit worried.
Question: How did Sarah feel about her first camping trip?
Opt_A: She was bored during the long drive.
Opt_B: She was happy but slightly nervous.
Opt_C: She was angry because of the weather.
Explanation: Sarah nói cô ấy 'excited but also a little bit worried', nghĩa là cô ấy vui vẻ nhưng hơi lo lắng một chút (nervous).

Passage:
Polar Bears

Polar bears are large, white bears that live in the Arctic, where it is very cold. They are the (19) ........ meat-eating animals on land. A male polar bear can weigh up to 800 kilograms!

These amazing bears spend most of their time (20) ........ the sea ice. They are excellent swimmers and can swim for many kilometers in the cold water to find food. Their favorite food is seals. Polar bears have a thick layer of fat under their skin, which helps to keep them (21) ........ in the freezing weather.

Mother polar bears (22) ........ birth to their babies, called cubs, in the winter. The cubs stay with their mother for about two years. She teaches them how to hunt and swim.

Sadly, polar bears are in danger because the ice in the Arctic is (23) ........ . If the ice disappears, they will not (24) ........ able to find enough food.
Evidence: They are the (19) ........ meat-eating animals on land.

Explanation: Cấu trúc so sánh nhất (the + tính từ ngắn + est) vì gấu trắng là loài thú ăn thịt trên cạn lớn nhất.

My favorite subject is science because we do lots of interesting experiments. The teacher is very kind and he explains things very (27) ........ . I have also joined the football team. We practice every Tuesday and Thursday afternoon.

(28) ........ you want to come and visit me soon? You can stay at my house for the weekend. We can play football in the park and play some video games. Please let (29) ........ know if you can come. I hope (30) ........ see you soon!

Best wishes,
Tom
Evidence: (28) ........ you want to come and visit me soon?
Question: Write ONE word for gap (28)
Explanation: Trợ động từ 'Do' để tạo câu hỏi Yes/No với chủ ngữ 'you' ở hiện tại đơn.

Passage:
Read this email from your English friend, Emma.

Let's go to the city center together this Saturday! Where should we meet? What do you want to do there? What do I need to bring?

Write an email to Emma and answer the questions. Write 25 words or more.
Question: Write an email to Emma.
Answer:
Hi Emma,
That is a great idea! Let's meet outside the central train station at 10:00 a.m. I want to go to the new bookshop and then eat pizza. You just need to bring some money and a jacket. See you soon!
[Your name]
Explanation: Email mẫu dài khoảng 43 từ, sử dụng ngữ pháp A2. Đã trả lời đủ 3 câu hỏi: Gặp ở đâu (train station), làm gì (bookshop & eat pizza), và mang gì (money and a jacket).

Passage:
Look at the three pictures.
Write the story shown in the pictures.
Write 35 words or more.

[Picture 1: A boy is buying a concert ticket at a ticket office.]
[Picture 2: The boy is looking worried and checking his empty pockets.]
[Picture 3: The boy is smiling because he finds the ticket inside his jacket pocket.]
Question: Write a story based on the pictures.
Answer: Yesterday, a boy named Mark bought a ticket for a rock concert. When he walked away, he checked his pockets but the ticket wasn't there. He felt very worried. Suddenly, he looked inside his warm jacket and found the ticket. He was so happy and smiled.
Explanation: Bài viết kể lại mạch lạc 3 bức tranh ở thì quá khứ (past simple) đúng với trình độ A2, dài khoảng 46 từ.
